purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for one Kalsa outer-road Stormshield watch handoff. This is website collateral and a visual lore stress test, not simulation state or model-training signal.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through anchors for the station approach, handoff room, target record, routine preparation, runner arrival, disputed overlap, final commitment, and four outcome families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for every change of place, focal object, arrival, physical evidence reveal, target disagreement, commitment threshold, and aftermath family. Branch actions that remain in one camera zone use explicit additive modifiers; success and cost endings use separate visible deltas.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base prompt names complete visible geometry, materials, light, weather, body placement, interfaces, tools, and important props for a general image model. Setting terms appear only after their visible form is described. Continuity notes remain reviewer constraints and never enter prompt assembly.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: hand-painted high-fantasy interactive-fiction illustration, gouache and ink on textured paper, strong readable silhouettes, storm-muted blue-gray stone and cloth, warm amber lamplight and broth steam, restrained magical ambiguity, humane facial detail, cinematic staging with practical work objects, abstract unlettered marks on all record surfaces.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each image prompt from the global_style_cue, visual refs only for named characters actually visible in that frame, the complete scene base_image_prompt, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Every text-only generation restates room geometry. A later replay render must also receive the declared camera-specific scene-set image once that blockout exists.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture returns to one room from roadward, table, mat, boundary, curtain, and aftermath angles. Character routes, the visitor rail, shutter sightline, recovery privacy, and object custody alter choices, so text prompts cannot own spatial continuity.
scene_set_guidance.required_scene_set: Build a plan view or simple 3D blockout of the outer-road station with the covered visitor stair, roadward shutter bay, three runoff channels beyond, low visitor rail and latch, scored table, wall hooks, two side-by-side trance mats, continuous grip rail, inner curtain, recovery bench, dry cityward stair, fixed lamp positions, and named camera slots below.
scene_set_guidance.promotion_rule: Until that durable geometry artifact exists, accept the fixture as prose/IF scaffold and BFL prompt batch only; do not label illustrated replay ready.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide exterior-to-interior establishing view of a squat thick-walled stone watch station built against a storm-lashed road above a dark southern gulf. A covered stone stair rises from the lower left through diagonal rain to a recessed visitor doorway. Three runoff channels cut past the exposed paving toward the gulf. Through deep shutter slats, warm amber lamplight reveals a compact workroom: a low interior rail, a waist-high scored table, two woven floor mats, and heavy timber supports. The unmoving sun is a dim fixed glow behind storm cloud, while rain and wind dominate the cold blue-gray scene.
visual_continuity_notes: The covered road stair is the only visitor route and ends outside the low interior rail.
The dry cityward stair is behind the recovery curtain and does not share the visitor entrance.
The shield itself has no invented visible dome, aura, or light wall.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide interior view of a compact rectangular stone station room. On the roadward wall at left, thick wooden shutters with narrow slats show rain and three bright runoff channels outside. A low waist-high wooden rail divides the visitor stair landing from the work floor. Center frame, a waist-high table has a scored map surface with fired-clay marker pieces, waxed slates, colored signal tiles, knotted wind cords, and several differently sized bronze handbells hanging on wall hooks. At right, two woven trance mats lie side by side beside one continuous polished wooden grip rail. Behind them, a heavy woven curtain conceals a small recovery alcove. Four workers occupy distinct stations: Nala kneels on the empty incoming mat, Orin grips the rail on the roadward mat, Ema stands at the scored table, and Tava watches from the curtain with a covered clay cup.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable visual identities for recurring named characters. Include only refs for characters visible in a frame.

characters.nala_ter: Nala Ter: tall broad-built human woman in her early thirties with warm brown skin, a broad nose, heavy jaw, two short blunt horn nubs at the hairline, thick black hair braided close for work, dark amber eyes, and large square hands. She wears an undyed layered wool tunic, storm-blue woven shoulder wrap, ochre sash, dark loose trousers, and soft-soled leather foot wraps. Her silhouette is grounded and wide through shoulders and hips; attentive posture is expressed through hand placement, jaw tension, and controlled breath.
characters.orin_vesh: Orin Vesh: broad-backed human man in his late fifties with deep brown skin, a wide weathered face, broad nose, one worn horn nub and one broken close to the hairline, iron-gray hair tied at the neck, gray stubble, and tired dark eyes. He wears a rain-dark charcoal wool wrap over a faded rust tunic, thick belt, loose work trousers, and damp leather foot wraps. His silhouette leans toward the grip rail; fatigue appears as white knuckles, forearm tremor, sagging shoulders, and delayed focus.
characters.ema_sai: Ema Sai: compact human adult in their forties with umber skin, square cheeks, close-cropped salt-and-black hair, small symmetrical horn nubs, and bare narrow attentive eyes. They wear a fitted moss-brown wool coat with rolled sleeves, a clay-red recording sash, wax-stained fingertips, dark trousers, and dry leather shoes. Their silhouette stays upright behind the table; authority appears through exact stylus movement, marker placement, and stillness.
characters.tava_en: Tava En: stocky human woman in her sixties with dark brown skin, rounded face, broad nose, short silver curls around two smooth horn nubs, and strong forearms. She wears a warm saffron-brown quilted vest over a cream work tunic, a dark green apron with cup cloth and spoon loops, loose trousers, and dry indoor wraps. Her silhouette is sturdy and forward-leaning, usually carrying a clay cup, blanket, ladle, or another practical care object.
characters.ket_oru: Ket Oru: lean long-legged human adult in their twenties with copper-brown skin, narrow face, broad nostrils, tiny horn buds at the temples, loose dark curls plastered by rain, and alert hazel eyes. They wear a soaked slate-blue hooded road cloak thrown back from the face, a short belted brown tunic, close work trousers, wrapped calves, and mud-dark leather boots. Their silhouette braces against wind with one shoulder forward; one hand protects a rectangular waxed road slate.

review_notes: No images were generated. This plan and its BFL batch are the complete visual deliverables for the fixture.
The room is multi-angle and branch-persistent, so a durable scene-set blockout is required before illustrated replay can be called ready.
The textual scene_set records current geometry intent for a future builder but is not itself render authority.
Papsenai-associated bovine features are individualized and remain human; the plan does not treat physique, temperament, intelligence, or docility as a universal ethnic fact.
Magic remains visually ambiguous: image prompts show storm, material traces, records, posture, and workload rather than an unsupported glowing shield.
